headline: TRAITORS 🗡️ CLAIM First BLOOD 🩸 as Richard E Grant TRIES to SAVE His SKIN 🧴
text:
TRAITORS 🗡️ snagged their FIRST 🥇 VICTIM ☠️ in the latest episode of Celebrity Traitors as a MURDER 🔪 and a RECRUITMENT 🪖 happened in the OPENING 🕒 minutes!! Maya Jama is SLAYING 💅 as a TRAITOR 🕵️ while Richard E Grant is in full DAMAGE 🛠️ CONTROL 🎛️ mode trying to patch up his SHAMBOLIC 🍑 first day!! A comedian 😂 a journalist 📰 an actor 🎭 and a TV presenter 📺 all walked into a CHURCH ⛪ but the PUNCHLINE 🥊 for one poor soul was getting COFFINED ⚰️ as the first celeb out!! Amol Rajan became the PALOMA FAITH 🎤 of the series getting TAKEN 🚑 away before he could even play in a BANISHMENT 🗳️!! "It's GUTTING 😣 to be the first out" Rajan said noting he was "a bit BULLISH 🐂 with Richard" earlier that day but hey games are GAMES 🎲 and there must be LOSERS 🥈!!

Next morning Claudia Winkleman confirmed the University Challenge host's MURDER 🔪 with a cheeky "That's what I call a starter for TEN 🔟" while newly recruited James Acaster was GUTTED 🥲 to no longer be a FAITHFUL 🙏 admitting "I don't like LYING 🤥 but if I don't JOIN 🫂 them they'll KILL ☠️ me" you can't fault that LOGIC 🧠!! The move let Grant an Oscar nominated thespian with a RAZZIE 🏆 worthy traitor STRATEGY 📜 at least pull off ONE ✅ successful MURDER 🩸 despite his earlier BAR 🍸 blunder where he straight up BLURTED 🗣️ that he was a TRAITOR 🕵️ to Joe Lycett Rob Beckett and half the CAST 🎬!! Obviously a man who NAILED 🎯 Spice Girls manager in Spice World is hard to picture as a baddie so everyone assumed it was some ELABORATE 🎭 double BLUFF 🃏!!

Maya Jama is OFF 🏎️ to a much stronger start confessing in the castle DIARY 📖 room "I am quite SHOCKED 😲 at my ability to just LIE 🤥 to everyone I'm an all or nothing kind of HONEY 🍯" while other players spun wild THEORIES 🕵️ like mathematician Hannah Fry spotting Leigh Anne Pinnock putting on MAKEUP 💄 late at night maybe heading to the TURRET 🏰!! Jerry Hall declared "I think it's JAMES" giving viewers hope the new cast hunts traitors better until she clarified she meant James BLUNT 🎸 not Acaster!! As they prepped for the MISSION 🛠️ conversations turned to far more IMPORTANT 📌 matters like Grant asking Rob Beckett "Do you have more TEETH 🦷 than a normal person" pure CHAOS 🌪️!!

The gang got BURIED ⚰️ alive in pairs for the challenge with only one duo staying above ground while Ross Kemp and Romesh Ranganathan were PRESELECTED 🛡️ by the traitors to stay SAFE 🛡️ and dig up GOLD 🪙 graves or FREE ⛏️ their mates!! They chose the LATTER opting to rescue everyone except Hannah Fry and Jerry Hall who bailed early when Hall screamed the emergency word "HAGGIS 🥟" basically the Scottish I'M A CELEBRITY 🦘 GET ME OUT!! It guaranteed one of them gets MURDERED 🔪 next unless the traitors RECRUIT 🪖 again with Fry telling Hall "Just you and me up for murder you'd better not be a TRAITOR 🕵️ or I'm really SCREWED 🔩"!! In a flashback Acaster explained protecting Kemp saying "he'll OVERTHINK 🧩 it and draw SUSPICION 👀" prompting Grant to call him "a wonderful TRAITOR 🕵️" certainly better than himself bro is DOWN BAD 😬!!

Finally it was time for the first BANISHMENT 🗳️ of the series with Grant still deep in DAMAGE 🛠️ CONTROL 🎛️ mode telling the diary room "I have a slight PINPRICK 📍 of advantage nobody would believe anyone would be so STUPID 🫠 as to say I am a traitor I'm hoping I get away with it"!! His fellow TRAITORS 🕵️ wanted to support him but things were getting DICEY 🎲 with Acaster calling him a "loose CANNON 🔫" and Jama saying "I want to SAVE 🛟 him even though he's dug himself the BIGGEST 🕳️ hole imaginable"!! Back in the castle Ranganathan pointed out if anyone else behaved like Richard they would just VOTE 🗳️ him out immediately but others thought "Richard feels a little too EASY 🪑" and pushing him might be SUSPICIOUS 👀!! Joanne McNally admitted he's made such a SHAMBLES 🍝 of it now while Julie Hesmondhalgh argued hard that his own confession was too CHAOTIC 🌪️ to ignore saying we'd be the most IDIOTIC 🤡 group of faithfuls if we ignored someone who walked in and said "I am a TRAITOR 🕵️"!!

Miranda Hart agreed the pure JOY 😂 when he took off his blindfold made him look SUS 🕵️ and as the episode ended before voting the players told Grant "You've given us all a PROBLEM ⚠️ by doing that it was a big mistake you forced our HAND 🖐️"!! The round table is shaping up like a LANDSLIDE 🏔️ against the 69 year old actor but we still wouldn't BET 💰 against him surviving this mess somehow!! Newly recruited James Acaster looks set to outlast his fellow traitor while Maya Jama keeps cooking 🔥 with her lies and the whole faithful crew is left spiraling in the castle wondering who to trust next!!
